title: Battles reach an end: resolve, and an AI that presses home
summary: Skirmishes against the AI now end in about 20 minutes, on resolve or on bases, instead of grinding on past half an hour.
rationale: Matched real-game captures show the player-facing reason on the victory banner and after-action report. The controlled near-zero resolve setup demonstrates feedback only, not normal battle duration or balance.
source_ref: 47194210 (merge of main into claude/pacing-victory-e2061b). Windowed off-screen render: --offscreen --host --team=0 --seed=3 --timescale=6 --perf=0 --screenshot --shot-at=330 at 1600x900; the top-left 1000x300 is kept (status line, order of battle, the FOB), JPEG quality 85.

sources.caption: Resolve on the status line: yours, theirs, and what you're losing a second (cropped from a 1600x900 frame).

capture.fixture: tests/fixtures/battle-outcome-clips.gd (same fixture copied into baseline checkout)
capture.setup: Attack scenario, seed 3, low preset; controlled held town; resolve 400 versus 2, bleed enabled immediately. Real victory rules and result UI. Capture-only UI wall clocks advance by 67 ms per frame so slow software rendering does not skip the animation. No performance or battle-duration claim.
capture.edit: Each take trimmed 4–14 seconds, scaled 1600x900 to 1280x720, labelled BEFORE/AFTER, concatenated; silent 20 seconds at 15 fps.
